name: usage-pet
description: A tiny cat above your Claude Code prompt that shows your 5-hour and weekly usage limits, and changes its face as you use them up.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the cat's lines. auto follows your system locale.

petStyle.title: Pet style
petStyle.description: kaomoji needs a CJK-capable font; pick ascii if you see boxes or question marks. auto uses kaomoji for Chinese/Japanese, ascii otherwise.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for reset times, e.g. Asia/Tokyo. auto uses this machine's time zone.

halfAt.title: Yellow from (%)
halfAt.description: Usage percent where the cat starts to look concerned.

warnAt.title: Red from (%)
warnAt.description: Usage percent where the cat gets worried.

outAt.title: Exhausted from (%)
outAt.description: Usage percent where the cat is out of energy.
